question: Bhanu Ji is associated with which of the following Gharanas of Kathak?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaipur**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bhanu Ji** is associated with the **Jaipur Gharana** of Kathak.
 
• The Jaipur Gharana is known for its intricate footwork and fast spins.
 
• It emphasizes the use of the entire body to convey the story and emotions of the dance.
